objective.title: Close M0 coordination and ready exact-rational extraction

declared.summary: Finalize the owner-mediated external exchange protocol and AURA baseline request, close M0 without claiming any external transmission, and ready the first exact-rational extraction leaf with concrete files and commands.
declared.value: Completes the full M0 foundation and hands DWF a directly executable M1 starting point, eliminating administrative gap runs while preserving strict cross-repository and evidence boundaries.
debtChanges: MATH-XR-001 remains draft with transmission none; no AURA acknowledgement, adoption, or mutation is claimed.
Actual M1 source extraction must re-check pinned AURA SHA-256 values and qualify ExactRational default/bounds before expanding to later quantity capabilities.
declared.nextAction: Execute M1-W01-C01-T1-R: install the pinned dw.quantities/ExactRational slice and independent exact-rational RED tests, preserving source provenance and the M0 transfer manifest.

achievements.achievement: The exchange-protocol question is bounded to owner-mediated transmission, recipient-owned mutation, evidence-backed external states, and independent Math product progress.
The canonical coordination contract and structured baseline request provide bounded evidence for request fields, state transitions, recipient scope, and expected responses.
The exchange lifecycle decision records draft through verified states, explicit evidence requirements, and the rule that local request files cannot fabricate external progress.
The cross-agent exchange contract is complete with stable lifecycle, authority, request content, evidence requirements, and response semantics.
The integration-boundary question is fixed around no cross-repository writes, no false sent/accepted states, explicit rollback, and recipient-owned consumer qualification.
MATH-XR-001 provides a pinned AURA baseline request covering direct-transfer sources, retained host files, adaptation sources, consumers, tests, and drift reporting while remaining untransmitted.

The rollback and external-state decision preserves prior recipient baselines, pins future adopted identity, separates baseline verification from adoption, and forbids duplicate removal before qualification.
The cross-repository boundary is qualified: Math prepares durable requests but performs no recipient mutation and claims no external adoption without evidence.
M0-W02-C03 is complete with the owner-mediated exchange protocol and a fully specified AURA baseline request that remains draft and untransmitted.
M0-W02 is complete: source rights, transfer architecture/localization boundaries, and cross-agent exchange/rollback are all durably qualified.
M0 foundations are complete: reproducible .NET tooling, native DWF adoption, source authority, transfer boundaries, and external coordination are qualified without performing AURA extraction.
